items.docs:
Creates a batch payout. In the JSON request body, pass a `sender_batch_header` and an `items` array. The `sender_batch_header` defines how to handle the payout. The `items` array defines the payout items.
You can make payouts to one or more recipients.
Notes:

  • PayPal does not process duplicate payouts. If you specify a sender_batch_id that was used in the last 30 days, the API rejects the request with an error message that shows the duplicat

params.name: id
params.description: The ID of the payout for which to show details.

params.name: fields
params.description: Shows details for only the specified fields.

params.name: page
params.description: A non-zero integer representing the page of the results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: The maximum number of results to return at one time. Value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. If the user chooses pagination, the maximum page is `1000`.

params.name: total_required
params.description: Indicates whether to show the total items and total pages count in the response.

items.docs: Shows the latest status of a batch payout. Includes the transaction status and other data for individual payout items.
